title: 你不是十二樓的嗎
mood: flirty recognition at three in the morning
subject: recognising the man from the twelfth floor who never says good morning on a warehouse dance floor at 3 a.m.
caption: Mandarin rave house-pop in the peak-time techno-house style. A four-on-the-floor 909 kick with an offbeat open hi-hat, a rolling sixteenth-note techno bassline, a squelching acid 303 line that opens up through the song, short rave piano stabs and a sidechained pad; a long filter-sweep breakdown where the kick drops out, then slams back in. Dark warehouse room sound, wide and pumping, the kick and the lead vocal forward. Confident female diva voice, breathy and half-spoken in the verses, a chanted one-line hook on the chorus doubled in unison by a second female voice. 126 BPM, G minor. Recognising someone at three in the morning and deciding to enjoy it. No trap hi-hats, no guitar, no ballad piano, no jazz-house Rhodes chords, no autotune, no tropical house plucks.
lyrics:
[Intro - 909 kick and rolling bassline, acid line creeping in]

[Verse 1]
凌晨三點 倉庫裡 煙霧機開太大
有人一直踩到我的腳 我轉頭準備罵
那副眼鏡 我每天早上在電梯裡都看到
他每天按十二樓 從來沒跟我說過早

[Pre-Chorus]
燈閃了一下 他也認出我了
他假裝不認識我 好 那我也裝

[Chorus]
你不是十二樓的嗎
平常領帶打到最上面 現在跳得比我還瘋
你不是十二樓的嗎
星期一電梯門一開 看你還裝不裝

[Verse 2]
他靠過來 在我耳邊用喊的自我介紹
他說他叫阿哲 在做稽核
我說我知道 你每天都買同一杯美式
他笑了 這是他第一次在我面前笑

[Breakdown - long filter sweep, kick drops out]
下一首 你還要不要跳

[Chorus - kick slams back in]
你不是十二樓的嗎
平常領帶打到最上面 現在跳得比我還瘋
你不是十二樓的嗎
星期一電梯門一開 早安 這次換你先說

[Outro - acid line and kick, fading]
十二樓 我記住了
